_comment: 活動的服事表 (rosters/ev_<event id>) over its life, as the app (app/lib/domain/event_roster.dart, which MemoryBackend follows), the Functions (functions/src/eventRosters.ts) and firestore.rules all have it. `fates`: what an event's roster does when its event changes, by whether it is `none` (there is none), `on`, or `cancelled` (its event deleted, kept for 復原): `follows` takes the event's title, days and group; `cancelled`; `movesOnto` the event made again by undoing a delete, under its new id; `reopens` in place (back from Google's trash). `by: app` rows are changes made in the app, which MemoryBackend makes too; `google` ones only the sync. `appWrites`: what the app may write over a roster's document, whoever arranges it (who may is testdata/church_rules.json rosterEditing): the title and days are the calendar's, set only when the roster is made; only the backend cancels one; an event's roster never turns into a service's day or back. Documents as Firestore has them; `cancelledAt: true` stands for a time. Add a row here before changing any side.

fates.why: edited in the app: its roster takes the new title and days
edited in the app with no roster: none is made
edited in the app while its roster is cancelled: it stays as it was
deleted in the app: its roster is cancelled, kept for 復原
deleted in the app with no roster: nothing
a delete undone: the cancelled roster moves onto the event made again
a delete undone over a roster still on: nothing moves
a delete undone with no roster: nothing
still in Google: its roster takes what Google has
back from Google's trash: its cancelled roster is on again where it was
gone from Google: its roster is cancelled
gone from Google and cancelled already: nothing

appWrites.why: a new event's roster, as the calendar has it
renamed by the app: the title is the calendar's
moved to another day by the app: the days are the calendar's
made longer by the app: its last day is the calendar's too
given to another group by the app: the group is the event's
cancelled with its event: only the backend changes it
a service's day never turns into an event's roster
an event's roster never turns into a service's day
